page_title: INT 3-0 CAG | Inter v Cagliari 17/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Cagliari work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+2' 3 - 0 3:0. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the top right corner of the net. What a finish that is! Elia Caprile did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Denzel Dumfries provided the assistance.

90+1' What a chance that is! Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Nicolo Barella and he is replaced by Andy Diouf (Inter).
87' Substitution. Jose Pedro walks off the pitch and Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.

86' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Denzel Dumfries (Inter) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
85' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Davide Frattesi (Inter) replaces Hakan Calhanoglu.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to Cagliari.

81' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
79' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and it's Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
78' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
76' That will be all from Adam Obert who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Ibrahim Sulemana.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Dimarco departs the field of play to be replaced by Luis Henrique (Inter).
76' Here is a change. Marcus Thuram is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
76' It will be a substitution. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Henrikh Mkhitaryan walks off.
74' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
73' A cross from a corner kick by Cagliari is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
73' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Corner kick. Cagliari will have an opportunity.
71' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
69' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marco Palestra (Cagliari). The ball goes out for a corner. Cagliari can continue in their attacking effort.
67' A pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is intercepted by Elia Caprile and the move breaks down.
66' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
64' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' The foul by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) was seen by Matteo Marchetti who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
60' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
59' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Yerry Mina (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play. Inter are awarded the free kick.
57' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Gaetano will be replaced by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
57' Gennaro Borrelli will be replaced by Paul Mendy (Cagliari).
56' 2 - 0 Goal! Nicolo Barella (Inter) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
56' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Marcus Thuram (Inter) inside the box.
54' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
52' 1 - 0 Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) scores after an assist by Federico Dimarco that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
50' A clever short pass gives Denzel Dumfries (Inter) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
48' A lofted cross from Marcus Thuram (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

43' Ambitious effort from Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
41' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.

40' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
39' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a chip pass into the box, but Elia Caprile is quickest to intercept the ball.
37' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
35' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
33' The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.

33' Carlos Augusto (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Inter earn a corner.
33' Inter quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
32' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a chip pass into the box, but Elia Caprile is quickest to intercept the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
30' Cagliari take a short corner kick.
29' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
23' Yellow card. Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.

19' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Inter are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Matteo Marchetti had a clear view and blows his whistle.

16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
13' Marcus Thuram (Inter) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
12' What a big chance! Marco Palestra (Cagliari) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
12' Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
11' A spell of possession for Cagliari in an attempt to control the game.
9' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Marcus Thuram almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

3' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Josep Martinez thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Now Cagliari have a corner.
2' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

2' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
